comment: AICore's own copy of the AI plugin policy (owner 2026-11-16: open source only, few choices, modifiable; nothing paid; Serum 2 manual only). The scan only looks for these .vst3 files; everything else on the PC is ignored. sha256 = the downloaded file (D:/AICore/plugins/downloads).

plugins.name: Vital
plugins.download: installed by the owner (2026-11-16, C:/Program Files/Common Files/VST3/Vital.vst3)
plugins.note: final render of synth roles in aicore-render (keeps legato/glide); .vital presets are the same JSON Vita reads, so the AI can tune a preset with Vita and render it with Vital

plugins.name: sfizz
plugins.note: drums and samples through SFZ kits built from D:/Samples. Owner OK 2026-11-16: downloaded https://github.com/sfztools/sfizz/releases/download/1.2.3/sfizz-1.2.3-win64.zip (sha256 7431cbe9b7f2e71a9ff4b12fbbe82c766dbf75b1eedecca627e7506cb06a9fcc) to D:/AICore/plugins/downloads; it holds the library and sfizz_render.exe (D:/AICore/plugins/sfizz-1.2.3-win64-lib), not the VST3. The VST3 only ships as an installer (sfztools/sfizz-ui 1.2.3, sfizz-1.2.3-win64.exe)

plugins.name: Airwindows Consolidated
plugins.note: ~500 effects, few parameters each; the algorithm is chosen in the plugin state; one fixed effect per role (state per role: to do)

engines.name: Vita
engines.note: Vital engine as a Python module; presets are .vital JSON. Not a VST3: rendered by its own service, never linked into aicore-render

engines.name: AICore sampler
engines.note: fallback for drums when sfizz is not installed: engine 'sampler' with params.kit
